items.name: Yangtze
facts: Longest river in Asia.
China’s principal river, the Chang Jiang.
Empties into the East China Sea at Shanghai.

items.name: Yellow River
items.fact: China’s Huang He; “cradle of Chinese civilization.”
facts: China’s Huang He; “cradle of Chinese civilization.”
China’s second-longest river.
Named for the loess silt it carries.

items.name: Amur
items.fact: Border river of China and Russia.
facts: Border river of China and Russia.
Known in China as the Heilong Jiang.
Forms much of the China–Russia land border.

items.name: Mekong
facts: Major river of Southeast Asia.
Forms stretches of the Laos–Thailand border.
Empties through the Mekong Delta in Vietnam.

items.name: Ganges
items.fact: Sacred river of the Indian subcontinent.
facts: Sacred river of the Indian subcontinent.
Joins the Brahmaputra in the world’s largest delta.

items.name: Indus
facts: Principal river of Pakistan.
Cradle of the Indus Valley civilization.

items.name: Ob
facts: Major west Siberian river.
Reaches the Arctic via the Gulf of Ob.

items.name: Yenisei
items.fact: Great Siberian river flowing to the Arctic.
facts: Great Siberian river flowing to the Arctic.
Among Asia’s longest rivers.

items.name: Lena
facts: Great east Siberian river.
Flows to the Laptev Sea in the Arctic.

items.name: Tigris
facts: Great river of Mesopotamia.
Joins the Euphrates at the Shatt al-Arab.

items.name: Euphrates
facts: Longest river in Western Asia.
Together with the Tigris, watered ancient Mesopotamia.

items.name: Brahmaputra
items.fact: Great river of Tibet, India, and Bangladesh.
facts: Great river of Tibet, India, and Bangladesh.
Joins the Ganges in the Bengal delta.

items.name: Lake Baikal
facts: World’s deepest freshwater lake.
Oldest large freshwater lake on Earth.
Holds about one-fifth of the world’s unfrozen fresh water.

items.name: Caspian Sea
items.fact: Largest inland body of water on Earth.
facts: Largest inland body of water on Earth.
A saline lake, not an ocean.

items.name: Aral Sea
items.fact: Once a great lake; now largely dried.
facts: Once a great lake; now largely dried.
Split between Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

items.name: Lake Balkhash
facts: Large endorheic lake in Kazakhstan.
Half fresh, half saline.

items.name: Tonlé Sap
facts: Southeast Asia’s largest freshwater lake.
Swells dramatically in the Mekong flood.

items.name: Issyk-Kul
facts: Largest lake in Kyrgyzstan.
An endorheic alpine lake that never freezes.

items.name: Qinghai Lake
facts: Largest lake in China.
A saline lake on the Tibetan Plateau.

items.name: Dead Sea
items.fact: Earth’s lowest land elevation on its shores.
facts: Earth’s lowest land elevation on its shores.
Among the saltiest large lakes.
Forms part of the Israel–Jordan border.

items.name: Lake Van
facts: Largest lake in Turkey.
A saline soda lake in Eastern Anatolia.

items.name: Lake Biwa
facts: Largest lake in Japan.
In Shiga Prefecture, near Kyoto.

items.name: Pacific Ocean
facts: Ocean east of Asia.
Earth’s largest ocean.

items.name: Indian Ocean
facts: Ocean south of Asia.

items.name: Arctic Ocean
facts: Ocean north of Siberia.

items.name: South China Sea
items.fact: Major sea of East and Southeast Asia.
facts: Major sea of East and Southeast Asia.
Among the world’s busiest shipping lanes.

items.name: East China Sea
items.fact: Between China, Korea, and Japan’s Ryukyu Islands.
facts: Between China, Korea, and Japan’s Ryukyu Islands.

items.name: Sea of Japan
items.fact: Between the Japanese archipelago and the mainland.
facts: Between the Japanese archipelago and the mainland.
Also called the East Sea.

items.name: Arabian Sea
facts: Northwestern Indian Ocean.
Between Arabia and the Indian subcontinent.

items.name: Bay of Bengal
facts: Northeastern Indian Ocean.
The world’s largest bay by area.

items.name: Bering Strait
facts: Separates Asia from North America.

items.name: Strait of Malacca
items.fact: Between the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra.
facts: Between the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra.

items.name: Strait of Hormuz
items.fact: The only sea entrance to the Persian Gulf.
facts: The only sea entrance to the Persian Gulf.

items.name: Taiwan Strait
facts: Between mainland China and Taiwan.

items.name: Persian Gulf
items.fact: Between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula.
facts: Between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula.

items.name: Red Sea
facts: Between Africa and Arabia.

items.name: Yellow Sea
items.fact: Between China and the Korean Peninsula.
facts: Between China and the Korean Peninsula.
Named for the Huang He’s silt.

items.name: Sea of Okhotsk
items.fact: Northwest Pacific sea of Russia’s Far East.
facts: Northwest Pacific sea of Russia’s Far East.
